The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams. This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership. Key Responsibilities: Advanced English - Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.
- Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.
- Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements. Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)- Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.
- Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.
- Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups. SAP BW Modeling & Transformations: o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based) o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including: o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures o CDS Views (where applicable)- Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.
- Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy. Reporting & Analytics: Oversee reporting solutions using: o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)- Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain). Migration & Modernization: Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including: o Readiness checks and simplification item handling o Remediation of custom code and data models o Data volume management and performance validation - Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective. Production Support & Governance - Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.
- Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation. Team & Stakeholder Leadership: - Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.
- Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.
- Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

Neste papel, cada integração importa: você atuará diretamente na criação de agentes usando o protocolo MCP e Python, conectando serviços e garantindo acesso ágil a dados. Trabalhará lado a lado com os times de engenharia, produto e a equipe de plataforma core da Sankhya, contribuindo desde o planejamento do nosso Data Lake até a transformação de protótipos de IA em produtos escaláveis. Se você gosta de autonomia e desafios complexos, tem forte capacidade de execução, é curioso(a) pelas últimas tendências de Inteligência Artificial e quer construir soluções inovadoras, vem com a gente! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência. RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES Construir e evoluir agentes de IA focados na automação de processos de RH e criação de interfaces conversacionais para os nossos produtos. Integrar esses agentes a serviços e APIs externas e internas, utilizando prioritariamente Python e o protocolo MCP. Colaborar ativamente com o time de plataforma da Sankhya no planejamento, mapeamento e documentação da estrutura de dados do Data Lake da BU de Gestão de Pessoas. Fazer a ponte técnica entre os protótipos funcionais de IA e o time de desenvolvimento, ajudando a traduzir os conceitos em produtos escaláveis. Navegar por um contexto cross-functional, conversando e extraindo entendimentos de diferentes áreas e empresas do grupo para construir soluções integradas. Atuar com autonomia na execução técnica, analisando cenários e estruturando caminhos viáveis para validação e tomada de decisão com a liderança. REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES Familiaridade forte e prática com modelos de linguagem (LLMs) e conceitos de Inteligência Artificial Generativa. Experiência com programação em Python, sendo a linguagem principal para a criação dos algoritmos e integração dos agentes. Conhecimento sólido no consumo, construção e integração de APIs. Noções de processos de ETL/ELT aplicados à manipulação e consolidação de bases de dados. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlata. DIFERENCIAIS Experiência com aplicações RAG e frameworks de orquestração de IA, como LangChain ou Llama Index. Conhecimento em plataformas e ferramentas de dados modernas, como BigQuery, Databricks ou Data Lakes. Experiência prática com arquitetura Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure). Vivência anterior no segmento de Recursos Humanos/HR Techs. Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade. Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis. Sobre nós: Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades. Visão geral da posição Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos. Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula. Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos. Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas. Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas. Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no. Formato Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI) Local: Remoto Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda Requisitos Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1) Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial). Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula. Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo). Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal. Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso. Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online. CNPJ / MEI ativo. Por que se juntar à nós? Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida. Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem. Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino. Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Shopify Developer (Remote | Pj)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Shopify Developer (Remote | Pj) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Theta Data Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape. We're a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we're just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously. The Role We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too! What You'll Do Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps What We're Looking For Required Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems Weekend support rotation Nice to Have Prior experience with financial data APIs Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation Why Theta Data Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter;
you will influence howwe operate Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

title: Analista De Experimentação Cro/Ux
description:

About Us YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It's Like to Work at YipitData YipitData isn't a place for coasting — it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Ownership That Matters: You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention About The Role We're looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS. You'll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. Possuir conhecimento específico sobre componentes eletrônicos ou sobre a indústria eletrônica, compreendendo as tendências de mercado e as necessidades dos clientes. 3. Os funcionários efetivos terão direito a gratificações por tempo de serviço, férias anuais remuneradas (de até 10 dias) e licença-maternidade remunerada. 3. A empresa organiza viagens anualmente e promove outras atividades periodicamente. 4. Convidamos regularmente profissionais de destaque do setor para treinamentos e aprendizado, além de realizarmos sessões de compartilhamento de experiências de negócios. 5. A empresa participa regularmente de feiras internacionais de eletrônicos todos os anos (nos Estados Unidos, Alemanha, Vietnã e Brasil). 6. a área de formação é flexível (preferência para cursos em Engenharia Eletrônica ou Marketing). 2. Boas habilidades de escuta, fala, leitura e escrita;
proficiência no uso doidioma inglês para comunicação e negociação com clientes. 3. Boas habilidades de comunicação, coordenação e execução;
capacidade de respostarápida e perspicaz;
forte senso de responsabilidade. 4. Experiência em técnicas e estratégias de vendas, incluindo habilidades de apresentação e negociação. 5. Forte capacidade de aprendizado e espírito de busca por aprendizado contínuo. 6. Aspiração em atuar e paixão pelo setor de comércio exterior e e-commerce. 7. Bom espírito de equipe.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Company Description Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale. Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains.The RoleThis is not a SaaS helpdesk role! It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role. You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does.In practice, that means:Owning the full customer relationship across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contactDriving onboarding and implementation as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six monthsAnalysing operational and customer data site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting themRunning Quarterly Business Reviews with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reportingMaintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalateSurfacing expansion opportunities — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to actSupporting renewal preparation 12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business caseYou'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product.What this role requiresFluent English: written and spoken;
all customer and internal work is conducted in English;
(additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese)Demonstrated experience managing more than three enterprise customers simultaneously, across multiple countries. If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fitExperience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts: you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over timeTechnical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translatorWillingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding)Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand companyWhat will make you stand outBackground in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similarExperience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS)Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalentActive, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis qualityFamiliarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologiesWhat you'll be measured onRelationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores.CompensationCompetitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

title: Power Electronics Pcb Design Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Power Electronics Pcb Design Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Turing Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Power Electronics PCB Design Expert to design, evaluate, and validate power electronic circuits and PCB layouts. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in power supply design, component selection, PCB layout best practices, and design verification methodologies. Key Responsibilties Design power electronic circuits including DC-DC converters, LDOs, AC-DC power supplies, and automotive power systems. Create schematics and PCB layouts using tools such as KiCad, Altium, or equivalent. Select components based on electrical, thermal, and reliability requirements. Perform design analysis for efficiency, ripple, thermal performance, EMI, and manufacturability. Generate manufacturing deliverables including BOMs, Gerber files, and assembly data. Validate designs through simulations, calculations, DRC/LVS checks, and design reviews. Develop and apply verification frameworks for schematic and PCB layout quality, including specification compliance, topology validation, component derating, DFM, thermal integrity, and power integrity. Required Skills Strong understanding of power electronics fundamentals (DC-DC converters, switching regulators, LDOs, power components). Hands-on experience with schematic design and PCB layout. Proficiency with PCB design tools (KiCad, Altium, or similar). Ability to interpret datasheets and validate component selection. Knowledge of DRC, manufacturability, grounding, routing, and EMI best practices. Preferred Skills Experience with AC-DC power supply design and automotive electronics. Familiarity with thermal analysis, power integrity, and simulation tools. Experience developing hardware validation or evaluation frameworks. Basic scripting experience (Python/terminal-based verification workflows). Qualification Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field. 5+ years of experience in power electronics and PCB design. Key Compentencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Attention to detail and design quality. Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams. Effective communication skills.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.Js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.Js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture.   • Projetar, implementar e sustentar arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e seguras em ambientes Multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP), garantindo alta disponibilidade, performance e alinhamento às melhores práticas de mercado;

  • Implementar soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e troubleshooting utilizando CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de incidentes críticos, realizando análises de causa raiz e garantindo estabilidade operacional dos ambientes;
  • Implementar e administrar soluções de segurança cloud, incluindo IAM, WAF, Security Groups, políticas de acesso, compliance e governança;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, realizando análise e otimização de custos dos ambientes cloud;
  • Desenvolver integrações e automações através de APIs e serviços de infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar projetosde dados e analytics utilizando serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e operações, apoiando decisões técnicas e arquiteturais;
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, workflows Git, gestão de repositórios e versionamento semântico;
  • Participar da definição de padrões arquiteturais, melhoria contínua e evolução tecnológica dos ambientes corporativos;
  • Criar e manter documentações técnicas, diagramas e padrões operacionais;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e hands-on em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade tecnológica.



Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior cursando ou completo;
  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura, administração e sustentação de ambientes Cloud Multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP);
  • Vivência em projetos de infraestrutura cloud escalável, resiliente e segura;
  • Conhecimento avançado em DevOps, GitOps e automação de infraestrutura;
  • Experiência prática com CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions e pipelines automatizados;
  • Forte experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform e CloudFormation;
  • Conhecimento emcontainers e orquestração com Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Amazon EKS e ECS;
  • Experiência em automação e integração via APIs para infraestrutura e operações;
  • Conhecimento emLinux, redes, SDN, armazenamento (SDS) e virtualização de containers;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de incidentes em ambientes complexos;
  • Conhecimento emsegurança cloud, IAM, WAF, Security Groups e boas práticas de governança;
  • Conhecimento embancos de dados e serviços de dados em cloud;
  • Experiência comserviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Overview


Most English schools in Brazil sell the same thing: promises. Promises of fluency. Promises of confidence. Promises of transformation. And most of them fail to deliver. Not because their teachers aren't capable, but because their model was never built around results in the first place.


AM Consultoria de Inglês was built differently.


We work exclusively with adult learners, using a communicative approach that prioritises real speaking ability. We measure what actually matters: whether our students can use English to do something meaningful with their lives. Every class, every follow-up, every piece of feedback we give is designed with that outcome in mind.


We're growing. And we're looking for a teacher who wants to be part of something that takes results seriously.


If you want a place to clock in, teach, and clock out, this isn't it. If you want to build something that genuinely changes people's lives, read on.



Position Details


  • Role: English Language Coach
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Employment Type: Contract
  • Start Date: Immediate


Candidates MUST be available Monday through Thursday, 7–9pm. Weekly team meeting: Mondays at 10am (30 minutes).



What You'll Do


  • Plan and deliver engaging, communicative classes that students actually remember
  • Support students via WhatsApp between sessions. We stay close to our learners
  • Proactively check in with students to understand their needs and keep them on track
  • Pursue your own professional development. We expect it and we support it



Technical Requirements


  • High-quality video and audio setup
  • Fast, stable internet connection



What We Require


  • CELTA, DELTA, or TKT certification (Cambridge)
  • C2 English proficiency
  • Strong command of Communicative Language Teaching methodology
  • Confident use of online teaching platforms and digital tools



What We're Looking For


Beyond qualifications, we're looking for someone who:


  • Brings genuine energy to every class, Not performance, real presence
  • Is ambitious and wants to grow, with potential to take on leadership responsibility
  • Receives feedback well and actively uses it to improve
  • Communicates proactively and takes ownership of their students' progress
  • Is humble enough to keep learning, no matter their level of experience
  • Has lived, worked, or studied in an English-speaking environment (a strong advantage)



Why AM Consultoria


  • Above-average compensation compared to the broader ESL market in Brazil
  • A methodology that actually works, and that you'll be proud to deliver
  • Adult learners who are motivated, goal-driven, and serious about progress
  • Real input into how we develop and improve our product
  • A small, high-performance team that holds each other to a high standard
  • Room to grow into more than a teacher



We'll be sharing more about our vision, mission, and approach via the link below. If what you've read here resonates — we'd like to hear from you.


Apply now.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.


Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM?

  • You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms.
  • You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments.
  • You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform.
  • You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

  • Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues.
  • Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations.
  • Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization.
  • Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments.
  • Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities.
  • Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.


WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR:

  • 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect.
  • Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix.
  • Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries.
  • Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus.
  • Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.


HOW YOU’LL RAMP:

  • By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.
  • By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews.
  • By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
    JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity. Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model. between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release Process Optimization: Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce "time-to-market" for new segments Market Insight: Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class Required Experience Communication Skills: Excellent English communication skills Proven PO Experience:3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment MarTech Experience: A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem, specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising Agile Software: Proficiency in Jira, Monday.Com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning Data Literacy: Ability to speak "data"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers Data Science Collaboration: A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists Project Precision: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the "fine print" during the QA process Stakeholder Influence: Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward High Impact Delivery: Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment Soft Skills: Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent Desired Experience Marketing Platforms: Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager Additional Information Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP About Velozient We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Role Overview: We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today's leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency. Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights. Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies. Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies. Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency. Desired Skills and Qualifications: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics. Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work. Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory. Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives. More details on required skills: Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage: Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships. Algebra and Number Theory Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications. Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions. Topology and Geometry Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques. Analysis Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning. Probability and Statistics Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis. Applied Mathematics Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

description:

Company US Door & More is a premium door manufacturing company focused on high-quality interior and exterior door systems for homeowners, builders, architects, and designers. We are building our internal CAD/CAM, CNC, and product development capability. We are looking for a practical, detail-oriented CAD/CAM Production Designer who can support daily production while also helping improve our products, drawings, documentation, and design details. Role Overview This is a hands-on technical role focused first on CAD/CAM and CNC production support. The day-to-day responsibility is creating CNC-ready files and programs for door fabrication. The daily production volume is manageable, but accuracy, organization, and manufacturing judgment are critical. In addition to CNC production work, this person will help create and improve technical drawings, 3D models, product details, user manuals, training illustrations, and new door designs. This is not a purely creative design role. It is also not a pure machine operator role. The right person should combine CAD/CAM skill, CNC logic, technical drawing ability, 3D modeling ability, production thinking, and good visual taste. Door, millwork, cabinetry, furniture, or woodworking experience is preferred, but not required. We have strong internal product knowledge and will train the right person on our door systems, construction methods, hardware standards, product rules, and manufacturing process. Role Balance Expected focus: 60% CAD/CAM and CNC production files 20% technical drawings, 3D models, BOMs, and production documentation 10% product improvement and production efficiency 10% new product design support, manuals, and training illustrations Key Responsibilities CNC / CAM Production Support Create CNC programs and machine-ready files for daily production. Convert drawings, measurements, and product requirements into CNC-ready outputs. Prepare toolpaths for routing, drilling, pocketing, mortising, profiling, and related machining operations. Review CNC files for accuracy, machining safety, material usage, and production efficiency. Coordinate with production to resolve CNC file issues, drawing questions, and machining problems. Help standardize CNC templates, file structures, machining logic, and repeatable workflows. Improve consistency and reduce avoidable errors in CNC production. CAD / Technical Drawings Create and update 2D CAD drawings for doors, panels, frames, glass layouts, hardware prep, and related components. Prepare shop drawings, production drawings, section details, and part drawings. Translate internal product knowledge into clear, organized drawings and templates. Support BOMs, cut lists, part breakdowns, and production notes. Maintain organized CAD files, drawing libraries, templates, and standards. 3D Modeling / Product Documentation Build clean 3D models of doors, components, assemblies, and product details. Create 3D illustrations for user manuals, installation guides, training materials, and internal documentation. Help document product construction, hardware locations, assembly steps, and production details. Create visual references that make technical information easier for production, sales, training, and customers to understand. Product Design / Product Improvement Assist with new door models, product collections, and design details. Improve existing product details for better appearance, strength, manufacturability, and efficiency. Review designs for proportion, material usage, CNC time, assembly time, finishing complexity, and production practicality. Help turn design ideas into production-ready products. Support continuous improvement in machining details, construction methods, and manufacturing workflow. Required Skills Strong CAD drafting ability. CAM/CNC programming experience. Ability to create or prepare CNC-ready files. Ability to read and create technical drawings. Strong 3D modeling ability. Understanding of dimensions, parts, materials, assemblies, and tolerances. About Us Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Cad/Cam Production Designer - Cnc & Product Development
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cad/Cam Production Designer - Cnc & Product Development em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company US Door & More is a premium door manufacturing company focused on high-quality interior and exterior door systems for homeowners, builders, architects, and designers. We are building our internal CAD/CAM, CNC, and product development capability. We are looking for a practical, detail-oriented CAD/CAM Production Designer who can support daily production while also helping improve our products, drawings, documentation, and design details. Role Overview This is a hands-on technical role focused first on CAD/CAM and CNC production support. The day-to-day responsibility is creating CNC-ready files and programs for door fabrication. The daily production volume is manageable, but accuracy, organization, and manufacturing judgment are critical. In addition to CNC production work, this person will help create and improve technical drawings, 3D models, product details, user manuals, training illustrations, and new door designs. This is not a purely creative design role. It is also not a pure machine operator role. The right person should combine CAD/CAM skill, CNC logic, technical drawing ability, 3D modeling ability, production thinking, and good visual taste. Door, millwork, cabinetry, furniture, or woodworking experience is preferred, but not required. We have strong internal product knowledge and will train the right person on our door systems, construction methods, hardware standards, product rules, and manufacturing process. Role Balance Expected focus: 60% CAD/CAM and CNC production files 20% technical drawings, 3D models, BOMs, and production documentation 10% product improvement and production efficiency 10% new product design support, manuals, and training illustrations Key Responsibilities CNC / CAM Production Support Create CNC programs and machine-ready files for daily production. Convert drawings, measurements, and product requirements into CNC-ready outputs. Prepare toolpaths for routing, drilling, pocketing, mortising, profiling, and related machining operations. Review CNC files for accuracy, machining safety, material usage, and production efficiency. Coordinate with production to resolve CNC file issues, drawing questions, and machining problems. Help standardize CNC templates, file structures, machining logic, and repeatable workflows. Improve consistency and reduce avoidable errors in CNC production. CAD / Technical Drawings Create and update 2D CAD drawings for doors, panels, frames, glass layouts, hardware prep, and related components. Prepare shop drawings, production drawings, section details, and part drawings. Translate internal product knowledge into clear, organized drawings and templates. Support BOMs, cut lists, part breakdowns, and production notes. Maintain organized CAD files, drawing libraries, templates, and standards. 3D Modeling / Product Documentation Build clean 3D models of doors, components, assemblies, and product details. Create 3D illustrations for user manuals, installation guides, training materials, and internal documentation. Help document product construction, hardware locations, assembly steps, and production details. Create visual references that make technical information easier for production, sales, training, and customers to understand. Product Design / Product Improvement Assist with new door models, product collections, and design details. Improve existing product details for better appearance, strength, manufacturability, and efficiency. Review designs for proportion, material usage, CNC time, assembly time, finishing complexity, and production practicality. Help turn design ideas into production-ready products. Support continuous improvement in machining details, construction methods, and manufacturing workflow. Required Skills Strong CAD drafting ability. CAM/CNC programming experience. Ability to create or prepare CNC-ready files. Ability to read and create technical drawings. Strong 3D modeling ability. Understanding of dimensions, parts, materials, assemblies, and tolerances. Understanding of manufacturing, fabrication, or production workflow. Good visual taste and sense of proportion. Strong attention to detail. Ability to learn technical product systems quickly. Clear communication with production, design, and management teams. Organized file management and documentation habits. Preferred Experience Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred: CNC programming CAD/CAM production CNC router work Woodworking Cabinetry Millwork Door or window manufacturing Furniture design or fabrication Architectural products Industrial design Product design Mechanical design Digital fabrication Shop drawings Manufacturing documentation BOMs and cut lists Preferred Software Experience Experience with one or more of the following: AutoCAD Fusion 360 SolidWorks Rhino Inventor SketchUp Cabinet Vision Microvellum Mozaik VCarve AlphaCAM Mastercam bSolid / BiesseWorks WoodWOP Other CNC/CAM software Exact software is less important than the ability to understand CAD/CAM logic, CNC production requirements, accurate modeling, and technical documentation. Strong Candidate Profile The ideal candidate may come from CNC programming, CAD/CAM design, cabinetry, millwork, furniture, woodworking, industrial design, product design, mechanical design, or digital fabrication. They do not need to already be a door expert. We can train the right person on door construction, terminology, product rules, hardware standards, and internal processes. They must already have the foundation: CAD/CAM skill, CNC understanding, technical drawing ability, 3D modeling ability, production thinking, attention to detail, and learning speed. Not a Good Fit This role is not a good fit for someone who: Only creates renderings or visual concepts. Has no CAM or CNC understanding. Cannot create accurate technical drawings. Cannot think in dimensions, materials, parts, assemblies, and tolerances. Has no interest in production or manufacturing details. Is only a machine operator and cannot draft or model. Is only a designer and cannot support production. Has good taste but weak technical discipline. Is technically capable but lacks visual judgment. Cannot organize files, drawings, and documentation clearly. Success in This Role Looks Like CNC files are accurate, organized, and ready for production. Production receives fewer unclear drawings and fewer avoidable CNC issues. CAD/CAM files, templates, and product documentation become more standardized. Product details become more efficient, consistent, and manufacturable. New door designs are attractive, buildable, and production-ready. Internal product knowledge becomes documented through drawings, models, manuals, and training materials. The company becomes faster and more consistent in turning product ideas into manufacturable products.

title: Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. title: Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Pocket FM is the world's largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing And Communications Coordinator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Hjelle Consulting Group (HCG) is a specialized network of regulatory affairs, regulatory science, and product pipeline design experts serving the agricultural technology sector. Led by former Monsanto Regulatory Vice President Jerry Hjelle, the team includes experienced strategists, scientists, and government affairs professionals with deep expertise across plant and on-plant products, including gene-edited crops, biotech plants, agricultural chemistries, microbials, and biologicals. HCG aims to deliver top-tier regulatory expertise and execution that has traditionally been available only to large multinational companies, and at a more accessible cost. Through a “Regulatory on Demand” model, HCG helps clients scale strategic and execution support as needed, reducing the burden of building in-house regulatory teams. The company’s ongoing engagement with client product pipelines also provides investors with confidence in the quality, design, and capital efficiency of the regulatory work supporting those products. Role Description Hjelle Consulting Group (HCG) is seeking an experienced Marketing & Communications Coordinator on a contract basis to support our growing thought leadership program in agricultural biotechnology regulation. This is a remote, operational role — you will own the execution of our content distribution, email marketing (Brevo), LinkedIn scheduling, and webinar coordination, working directly with senior regulatory scientists to extract and amplify their expertise to a global B2B audience. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in agbiotech, agricultural inputs, or regulatory affairs marketing, writes and communicates with precision in English, and thrives in a lean, self-directed environment where building systems matters as much as executing them. Portuguese proficiency is a plus. If you have managed marketing operations for a technical B2B firm and understand what it means to communicate credibly to scientists, regulators, and investors — we want to hear from you.
